reading: Volodymyr Zelensky has expressed conditional support for a proposed 'energy ceasefire' between Ukraine and Russia, which Donald Trump claimed was already in effect.
Trump had insisted that the truce was 'effective immediately' but did not provide any specific details.
Zelensky initially expressed surprise at the announcement, then confirmed Kyiv would back the measure if Moscow also agreed.
However, Ukraine's President also accused Russia of striking Ukrainian energy facilities after Trump's public post.
Trump has been advocating for Ukraine to halt its strikes on Russian oil infrastructure, arguing this would allow Russia to release diesel to the US and global market.
This controversial diesel deal, which temporarily lifts sanctions on Russian imports, has drawn increasing condemnation.
Zelensky explicitly called the agreement a 'gift' to Russian President Vladimir Putin, a sentiment echoed by European officials and some US politicians.
Trump's latest initiative aims to lower domestic fuel prices before the midterm elections, following months of political backlash from a separate conflict.
The higher pump prices and subsequent knock-on effects have soured Trump's standing with the American public, contributing to widespread inflation.
Ukraine and Russia have engaged in months of retaliatory strikes targeting each other's energy infrastructure.
Moscow asserts these installations are legitimate targets supporting Ukraine's military operations, while Kyiv views its attacks as essential to curtailing Russia's war finance capabilities.
These sustained attacks have consequently disrupted energy supplies across both nations.
Seven senators from both major US parties have issued a statement declaring Trump's deal 'runs directly counter' to a law prohibiting Russian energy imports.
They urged the Trump administration to 'reverse course', emphasizing that Congress's intention was clear: no Russian oil imports until aggression against Ukraine ceases.
Republican Senator Thom Tillis stated that the deal 'absolutely will' endanger American lives.

vocabulary.definition: Dependent on certain terms or circumstances; not absolute.
Demanded something forcefully, not accepting any refusal.
Publicly supporting or recommending a particular cause or policy.
The expression of very strong disapproval; censure.
In a clear and detailed manner, leaving no room for confusion or doubt.
An opinion or feeling that was repeated or shared by others.
A strong, negative reaction by a large number of people, especially to a political or social development.
Caused to become unpleasant, difficult, or problematic; spoiled.
Characterized by an action that harms someone in return for an injury or offense.
Reducing in extent or quantity; imposing a restriction on.

entries.ja: 特定の条件や状況に依存しており、絶対的ではないこと。
entries.ko: 특정한 조건이나 상황에 의존하며, 절대적이지 않은.
entries.zh-Hans: 依赖于特定条款或情况，而非绝对的。
entries.es: Que depende de ciertas condiciones o circunstancias; no es absoluto.
entries.pt-BR: Que depende de certas condições ou circunstâncias; não é absoluto.
entries.fr: Qui dépend de certaines conditions ou circonstances; qui n'est pas absolu.
entries.de: Von bestimmten Bedingungen oder Umständen abhängig; nicht absolut.

entries.ja: 拒否を一切受け入れず、何かを強く要求した。
entries.ko: 어떤 거절도 받아들이지 않고 무언가를 강력하게 요구했다.
entries.zh-Hans: 强烈要求某事，不接受任何拒绝。
entries.es: Exigió algo con fuerza, sin aceptar ninguna negativa.
entries.pt-BR: Exigiu algo com força, não aceitando qualquer recusa.
entries.fr: A exigé quelque chose avec force, n'acceptant aucun refus.
entries.de: Forderte etwas nachdrücklich, ohne eine Ablehnung zu akzeptieren.

entries.ja: 特定の原因や政策を公に支持したり、推奨したりすること。
entries.ko: 특정 대의나 정책을 공개적으로 지지하거나 추천하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 公开支持或推荐特定的事业或政策。
entries.es: Apoyar o recomendar públicamente una causa o política en particular.
entries.pt-BR: Apoiar ou recomendar publicamente uma causa ou política específica.
entries.fr: Soutenir ou recommander publiquement une cause ou une politique particulière.
entries.de: Eine bestimmte Sache oder Politik öffentlich unterstützen oder empfehlen.

entries.ja: 非常に強い不承認の表明。非難。
entries.ko: 매우 강력한 불승인을 표현하는 것; 비난.
entries.zh-Hans: 表示非常强烈的不赞成；谴责。
entries.es: La expresión de una desaprobación muy fuerte; censura.
entries.pt-BR: A expressão de uma desaprovação muito forte; censura.
entries.fr: L'expression d'une très forte désapprobation; la censure.
entries.de: Der Ausdruck sehr starker Missbilligung; Tadel.

entries.ja: 混乱や疑いの余地を残さず、明確かつ詳細な方法で。
entries.ko: 혼란이나 의심의 여지를 남기지 않고 명확하고 상세한 방식으로.
entries.zh-Hans: 以清晰详细的方式，不留混淆或疑问的余地。
entries.es: De manera clara y detallada, sin dejar lugar a confusión o duda.
entries.pt-BR: De maneira clara e detalhada, não deixando margem para confusão ou dúvida.
entries.fr: De manière claire et détaillée, ne laissant aucune place à la confusion ou au doute.
entries.de: Auf eine klare und detaillierte Weise, die keinen Raum für Verwirrung oder Zweifel lässt.

entries.ja: 他の人によって繰り返されたり、共有された意見や感情。
entries.ko: 다른 사람들에게 반복되거나 공유된 의견이나 감정.
entries.zh-Hans: 被他人重复或分享的观点或感受。
entries.es: Una opinión o sentimiento que fue repetido o compartido por otros.
entries.pt-BR: Uma opinião ou sentimento que foi repetido ou compartilhado por otros.
entries.fr: Une opinion ou un sentiment qui a été répété ou partagé par d'autres.
entries.de: Eine Meinung oder ein Gefühl, das von anderen wiederholt oder geteilt wurde.

entries.ja: 特に政治的または社会的な発展に対する、多くの人々による強い否定的な反応。
entries.ko: 특히 정치적 또는 사회적 발전에 대해 많은 사람들에 의한 강한 부정적인 반응.
entries.zh-Hans: 大量人群对某一政治或社会发展所产生的强烈负面反应。
entries.es: Una reacción fuerte y negativa por parte de un gran número de personas, especialmente a un desarrollo político o social.
entries.pt-BR: Uma reação forte e negativa por um grande número de pessoas, especialmente a um desenvolvimento político ou social.
entries.fr: Une réaction forte et négative d'un grand nombre de personnes, notamment à un développement politique ou social.
entries.de: Eine starke, negative Reaktion einer großen Anzahl von Menschen, insbesondere auf eine politische oder soziale Entwicklung.

entries.ja: 不快に、困難に、または問題のある状態にさせた。台無しにした。
entries.ko: 불쾌하거나, 어렵거나, 문제가 있는 상태가 되게 했다; 망쳤다.
entries.zh-Hans: 导致变得不愉快、困难或有问题；破坏了。
entries.es: Hizo que algo se volviera desagradable, difícil o problemático; lo estropeó.
entries.pt-BR: Causou que algo se tornasse desagradável, difícil ou problemático; estragou.
entries.fr: A rendu quelque chose désagréable, difficile ou problématique; a gâché.
entries.de: Führte dazu, dass etwas unangenehm, schwierig oder problematisch wurde; verdarb.

entries.ja: 危害や攻撃に対する報復行為によって特徴づけられる。
entries.ko: 상해나 공격에 대한 보복 행위로 특징지어지는.
entries.zh-Hans: 以报复性行动为特征，以伤害回应伤害或冒犯。
entries.es: Caracterizado por una acción que daña a alguien en respuesta a un agravio u ofensa.
entries.pt-BR: Caracterizado por uma ação que prejudica alguém em retribuição a um dano ou ofensa.
entries.fr: Caractérisé par une action qui nuit à quelqu'un en retour d'un tort ou d'une offense.
entries.de: Gekennzeichnet durch eine Handlung, die jemandem als Vergeltung für eine Verletzung oder Beleidigung Schaden zufügt.

entries.ja: 範囲や量を減らすこと。制限を課すこと。
entries.ko: 범위나 양을 줄이는 것; 제한을 가하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 在范围或数量上进行削减；施加限制。
entries.es: Reducir en extensión o cantidad; imponer una restricción a.
entries.pt-BR: Reduzir em extensão ou quantidade; impor uma restrição sobre.
entries.fr: Réduire l'étendue ou la quantité; imposer une restriction à.
entries.de: Umfang oder Menge reduzieren; eine Beschränkung auferlegen.
